CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)

   B. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   D. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
